[[Containment]] |sandbox = No |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Farms will not give cash.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Farm Banned''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that appears in event maps. It makes [[Farm]]s not generate any cash when used. '''Farm Banned''' is active on all matches in [[Failed Gateway]], [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]]. ==Effects== When the '''Farm Banned''' modifier is active, [[Farm]]s will generate zero cash, rendering them useless. It can still generate thorns in conjugation with the [[Harvester]]. The [[Cowboy]] and [[DJ Booth]]'s cash generations are unaffected. ==Trivia== *The effect this modifier applies has been in the game for years, being used in multiple events, such as [[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]]. **However, there was no indicator that the generation of cash through the [[Farm]] was disabled until [[Hexscape Event]], though the indicator was only added a few days after its release. *While the '''Farm Banned''' modifier did not disable the placement of the [[Farm]] outright, [[Cold Ambush]] and [[D00M's Revenge]] did, though not through a modifier. *The icon for this modifier uses the Level 4 Default [[Farm]] gallery image which is used on this wiki, with the photo being captured and uploaded by [[User:WikiaColors|WikiaColors]]. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0|v1.38.2]] **'''Farm Banned''' added. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Farm Banned''' is now active in [[Containment]]. {{ModifierNavBox}}
